scenes.line1: How does Git fit into infra work?
scenes.say: How does Git actually fit into infrastructure work? And why do we always use branches?

scenes.label: Branches
scenes.sub: Work safely in parallel. Try changes without risk.
scenes.say: Branches let you work safely in parallel. You can try changes without risking the main code.

scenes.title: Infra workflow
lines: $ git commit -m "Raise nginx proxy timeout to 60s"
scenes.say: Clone the repo, make a branch, edit files, add, commit, and push your changes. That's your basic flow.
Next, open a pull request. Reviewers and automated checks catch issues before you merge to main.

scenes.question: Should you commit directly to main?
scenes.right: No. Always use a branch and pull request for reviews.
scenes.say: Here's a trap: Should you commit directly to main? No way. Always use a branch and pull request so changes get reviewed.
